author: Atomic Shrimp
description:
In a recent video of his, my friend Babatunde mentioned something called Concoction Rice - this is a hardship dish in Nigeria, made with very few ingredients.  We decided to make these collab videos about it.

Link to Babatunde's video: https://youtu.be/NxvylV_tOT8
